title: Wactorz: Self-Writing LLM Agents That Discover, Repair, and Migrate at the Edge
abstract: arXiv:2611.29619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most LLM agent frameworks build a crew that runs a task and exits. Physical environments (e.g., homes, labs, factory floors) need agents that stay up for months, survive their own bugs, and run on whatever hardware is already next to the sensors. We present Wactorz, an open-source runtime in which LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors: a planner turns a chat request into Python, compiles it into a new actor at runtime, and a supervisor restarts that actor alone, with its state intact, when it crashes. All coordination rides on MQTT, so agents can be spawned on, and live-migrated between, edge nodes such as a Raspberry Pi, and every internal event is a topic external systems can subscribe to. The recorded demo builds a camera-to-lamp automation from one chat request, adds a second agent that is auto-wired to the first by topic and carries a deliberate division-by-zero, watches that agent repair its own code without losing

translated_title: Wactorz：能在边缘自行发现、修复和迁移的自编写LLM智能体
translated_abstract: 大多数LLM智能体框架构建的团队在执行完任务后就会退出。而物理环境（如家庭、实验室、工厂车间）需要能够持续运行数月、从自身缺陷中恢复、并运行在传感器旁现有硬件上的智能体。我们提出了Wactorz，一个开源运行时系统，其中LLM生成的智能体是长生命周期、受监督的actor：规划器将聊天请求转换为Python代码，并在运行时将其编译为新的actor；当某个actor崩溃时，监督者仅重启该actor，且其状态保持完整。所有协调都基于MQTT进行，因此智能体可以在边缘节点（如树莓派）上生成，并可在节点之间实时迁移，同时每个内部事件都是一个可供外部系统订阅的主题。录制的演示通过一个聊天请求构建了从摄像头到灯具的自动化，随后添加了第二个通过主题自动连接到第一个智能体的新智能体，并故意带有除以零的错误，观察该智能体在不丢失状态的情况下自行修复其代码。
tldr: 提出了开源运行时Wactorz，其中LLM生成的智能体作为长生命周期、受监督的actor运行，可基于MQTT在边缘节点间实时迁移，并能在不丢失状态的情况下自主修复自身代码缺陷。
en_tdlr: Wactorz is an open-source runtime where LLM-generated agents are long-lived, supervised actors that live-migrate across edge nodes via MQTT and autonomously repair their own bugs without losing state.
